# js-yaml

`js-yaml-4.1.1.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of js-yaml 4.1.1.

- Source: https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/tree/4.1.1
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/js-yaml/-/js-yaml-4.1.1.tgz
- Package SHA-512: `qQKT4zQxXl8lLwBtHMWwaTcGfFOZviOJet3Oy/xmGk2gZH677CJM9EvtfdSkgWcATZhj/55JZ0rmy3myCT5lsA==`
- Browser file SHA-256: `0de3dec92d20eab9e0b46a5d928cd45ec025d73e348ddf458dbfb01da00cb473`
- License: MIT; see `js-yaml-LICENSE`.

The parser is bundled for offline use. Hydro imports use its JSON schema and do not load executable YAML types.
